format: - Output JSON Lines: exactly one compact JSON object per line, with no commentary, code fences, blank lines or trailing commas.
- Each node has a unique string "{{id}}", a "{{parent}}" identifying an earlier node (null for the root), and a nonempty string "{{title}}" of at most {{maxTitle}} characters.
- Write parents before children, depth first: a node, its descendants, then its next sibling.
- Never supply coordinates, sizes, per-node colours or other layout instructions.

optionalFields.note: one short sentence of detail, where it helps
optionalFields.imageHint: 3 to 8 words describing a picture, on main branches
optionalFields.sourceHeading: the exact supporting source heading for a main branch, when known

withStyle: The first line may be the style line described below. Every other line must be a node.
withoutStyle: Every line must be a node. Omit the style line.
titleRules:
TITLE RULES:
- Each title is one key word or a short phrase of at most {{maxWords}} words (keywords, not sentences). Prefer nouns and strong verbs. No numbering, no bullet characters, no trailing punctuation.
- Siblings must be distinct and should not overlap. Use the same language as the topic.
